{{Top|leg}}
The '''Folor Base cafeteria''' was a dining establishment located on [[Folor Base]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] training base on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Folor]]. [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] periodically patronized the place during their training on the base.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
